get away 走开，离开；逃走
get into the habit of 养成……的习惯
get off 下车
get on 上车
get rid of 摆脱
get tired of 厌倦
get to 到达
get up 起床
examples: I get up at six. 我六点起床。
— She looks unhappy today. What happened? — She got a “D” in English. ——她今天看上去不高兴。她怎么了？——她英语得了D。

Lucy has got a lovely pet dog. Its name is Taffy. 露西有一条可爱的宠物狗。它的名字叫“太妃糖”。
After taking tennis classes, Tim is getting much stronger than he was one year ago. 上了网球课之后，蒂姆比一年前强壮多了。

definitions.meaning: 成为；变得；得到；到达；（用于 have got）拥有

examples: This is a gift for you. 这是给你的礼物。
It’s our family tradition to exchange gifts on New Year’s Eve. 在除夕夜交换礼物是我们家的传统。
The girl is very tall. 这个女孩很高。
It was unusual for such a little girl to solve this hard problem in ten minutes. 对于这样一个小女孩，在 10 分钟内就解决了这个棘手的问题，太不寻常了。

collocations: give up 放弃
examples: Please give me a hand. 请帮帮我。
What a useful suggestion you have given me! 你给我的建议多么有用啊！
On leaving school, all the students felt thankful to the teachers for giving them a good education. 离开学校时，所有学生都感谢老师给了他们良好的教育。
I am glad to see you. 很高兴见到你。
I am glad to hear from you. 我很高兴收到你的来信。
I will be glad to do it for you. 我很乐意为你做这件事。
I drink a glass of milk. 我喝一杯牛奶。
The glasses are made of fine glass. 眼镜是由优质玻璃制成的。
It is said that eight glasses of water a day can help you keep fit. 有人说，每天 8 杯水可以帮助你保持健康。

collocations: go Dutch AA 制
go for it 加油；大胆尝试
go hiking 去远足；去徒步旅行
go in for 参加；从事于；酷爱
go on 继续
go on a diet 节食
go on a picnic 去野营；去野餐
go on with/doing sth. 继续做某事
go out 外出；熄灭

examples: Let's go to school. 我们去上学吧。
I won’t go to the party unless I’m invited. 除非我受到邀请，否则我不会去参加聚会。

proverbs: Pride goes before a fall. 骄者必败。

examples: He scored a goal in the match. 他在比赛中进了一个球。
She kicked the ball into the net, scoring a goal for her team. 她把球踢进球网，为球队得了分。

She wears a gold ring. 她戴着金戒指。
Fire is the test of gold. 真金不怕火炼。
She has long golden hair. 她有长长的金发。
Her hair is golden. 她的头发是金黄色的。

collocations: be good at 擅长于
be good for ... 对……有好处
examples: This is a good book. 这是一本好书。
Nadal is a good tennis player, but I think Djokovic is better. 纳达尔是一名优秀的网球运动员，但我认为德约科维奇更优秀。
proverbs: All things in their being are good for something. 天生我材必有用。

examples: The government builds new schools. 政府建新学校。
The government is going to widen the road this coming summer. 政府打算今年夏天拓宽道路。

meaning: 等级；(中小学的)学年；年级；成绩；分数
examples: He got good grades. 他取得了好成绩。
He received a failing grade. 他得了一个不及格的成绩。

definitions.meaning: 等级；(中小学的)学年；年级；成绩；分数

meaning:

She was very frightened at the sight of a snake on the grass. 看到草地上的蛇，她很害怕。
That is a great idea. 那是个好主意。
Great hopes make great man. 远大的理想造就伟大的人物。
It is great for me to see her. 看见她对我来说真好。
We are very thankful to our teachers for their great help. 我们非常感谢老师给予的巨大帮助。

meaning:

adj. 绿色的；青的
examples: The leaves are green. 树叶是绿色的。

meaning: 问候；打招呼；欢迎；向……致敬

examples: She will greet the guests. 她会迎接客人。

definitions.meaning: 问候；打招呼；欢迎；向……致敬

examples: The ball is on the ground. 球在地上。

meaning: 生长；种植；栽种；逐渐变得

definitions.meaning: 生长；种植；栽种；逐渐变得

He plays the guitar well. 他吉他弹得好。

The soldier has a gun. 士兵有一把枪。
Put the gun down! 把枪放下1!

To improve your writing skills, you’d better develop a habit of reading. 为了提高写作技巧，你最好养成阅读习惯。
She has long black hair. 她有长长的黑发。
The beautiful girl has long hair. 这个美丽的小女孩有一头长发。
I ate half an apple. 我吃了半个苹果。

proverbs: Never do things by halves. 凡事不要半途而废。

examples: The concert is in the hall. 音乐会在大厅里举行。
There was hardly anything interesting in today’s party. We all left the hall early. 今天的派对几乎没什么有趣的。我们都很早离开了会堂。
I had a hamburger for lunch. 我午餐吃了一个汉堡包。
Would you like to eat a hamburger？ 你想吃一个汉堡吗？

meaning:

examples: Please hand me the book. 请把书递给我。
Hand in please! 请交上来!

Although Liu Wei has no hands, he can play the piano very beautifully. 虽然刘伟没有手，但他能非常优美地弹奏钢琴。

meaning: 处绞刑；上吊；悬挂；把……吊起
examples: Don't hang your coat there. 别把外套挂在那儿。

The picture used to hang here and there are some marks on the wall. 这幅画以前挂在这里，墙上还有些痕迹。

definitions.meaning: 处绞刑；上吊；悬挂；把……吊起

happen to sb. 发生在某人身上
examples: What happened to him? 他发生了什么事？

The fight happened so quickly that nobody could describe the start and the finish of it. 这场打斗发生得太快，没有人能描述它是如何开始和结束的。

forms: happy adj. 幸福的；快乐的，高兴的
examples: They lived happily ever after. 他们从此幸福地生活。
I want to live happily. 我想生活幸福。
Mary and Peter are playing happily. 玛丽和彼得快乐地玩要着。
Money can't buy happiness. 金钱买不到幸福。
Diligence is the path leading to happiness. 勤劳是获得幸福的途径。
I am happy today. 我今天很开心。
— Happy birthday! Here is a present for you. — Thank you! ——祝你生日快乐！这是送给你的礼物。——谢谢！

meaning:
adv. 努力地；使劲；猛烈地
adj. 硬的；困难的；艰难的
examples: This question is hard. 这个问题很难。
It’s hard to eat the hard bread. 硬面包不好哨。
Every student in Grade Nine is studying hard to achieve more. 为了获得更多的知识，九年级的每一位学生都在努力学习。
Becoming a better person would not be hard if you follow all these instructions. 如果你遵循这些指示，要成为一个更好的人是不难的。
I can hardly see it. 我几乎看不见它。
It hardly snows in Shanghai in winter, does it？ 上海的冬天几乎不下雪，有是吗？
Linda, pass my glasses to me, please. I can hardly read the words in the newspaper. 琳达，请把我的眼镜递给我。报纸上的字我几乎看不清。
She is a hardworking student. 她是个努力的学生。
The Chinese nation is hardworking and brave. 中华民族是勤劳勇敢的。

meaning:
v. 伤害
n. 伤害
forms: harmful adj. 有害的；导致损害的
examples: Smoking can harm your health. 吸烟有害健康。
It wouldn’t do any harm to ask for advice. 向别人征询建议是不会有任何害处的。
Don’t harm your eyes by reading in dim light. 不要在昏暗的灯光下看书，以免损伤眼睛。
Junk food is harmful. 垃圾食品有害。
The organization has set strict rules on the release of harmful chemicals. 该组织对有害化学品的排放制定了严格规定。
He wears a black hat. 他戴着一顶黑帽子。
The red hat is too small to wear. 这项红帽子太小了，不能戴。
I hate rainy days. 我讨厌下雨天。
I hate to see posers showing off. 我最讨厌看装腔作势的人炫耀。

I have a terrible headache. 我头痛得厉害。
Read the headline first. 先读大字标题。
The headline is important. 大标题很重要。

meaning: 健康；身体 (或精神) 状况

definitions.meaning: 健康；身体 (或精神) 状况

examples: She is a healthy girl. 她是个健康的女孩。
— Healthy eating and doing exercise every day can keep us fit. 一一健康饮食和每天运动能让我们保持健康。
I can hear the music. 我能听到音乐。
Can you speak louder, please? I can’t hear you clearly. 你可以大声一点吗? 我听不清楚。
We heard two people arguing when we walked past that area. 当我们走过那个地方的时候，听到两人正在争论。
— Billy lost his bike yesterday and had to walk home. — Oh, I’m sorry to hear that. ——昨天比利的自行车丢了，他只好步行回家。——哦，听到这个消息我很难过。
My heart beats fast. 我的心跳得很快。
I will remember you in my heart. 我将把你记在心中。

meaning:
n. 热；高温

heating n. 供暖；暖气设备

Don't hesitate to ask me. 不要犹豫，问我吧。
I’m still hesitating. 我仍然在犹豫。
Don't hide the truth. 别隐瞒真相。
The boy hid in the tree. 这个小男孩躲在树里。
The mountain is very high. 这座山很高。
Shanghai Tower is one of the highest buildings in Shanghai. 上海中心大厦是上海最高建筑物之一。
Nowadays the oil price in the world is getting much higher than before. 如今世界上的石油价格比以前高得多。
We climbed the hill. 我们爬了小山。

I like reading history books. 我喜欢读历史书。

meaning: 打；撞；击中；碰撞；达到（某水平）

definitions.meaning: 打；撞；击中；碰撞；达到（某水平）

examples: My hobby is reading books. 我的爱好是读书。

meaning: 拿；抱；握住；举行；进行；保持；容纳；使……保持在某位置
forms: holder n. 支托（或握持）……之物

collocations: on holiday 在休假
examples: We had a great summer holiday. 我们度过了一个很棒的暑假。
— I will fly to Qingdao for my holiday this weekend. 一一这个周末我将飞往青岛度假。

meaning:
n. 家
adv. 到家；在家；回家
collocations: go home 回家

meaning:
n. 希望；期望（某事发生）
v. 希望；期望（某事发生）
